title: The 5 Best Pet Cameras Under $60
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for pet cameras under $60, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pet cameras under $60 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: TP-Link Tapo C210
products.blurb: Key specs: 2K resolution, 360° pan / 114° tilt, Motion detection with tracking, MicroSD storage up to 512GB.
strengths: Sharpest image of any camera in this list at 2K resolution
Local microSD storage up to 512GB avoids a mandatory subscription
360° pan covers a full room from a single mounting point
limitations: 114° tilt range is narrower than the Wyze Cam Pan's full 180°
App setup has a few more steps than Ring's for first-time users
features: Works with Alexa and Google Assistant

products.name: Wyze Cam Pan v3
products.blurb: Key specs: 360° pan / 180° tilt coverage, 1080p color night vision, Pan Scan auto-patrol with 4 waypoints.
strengths: Full 180° tilt is the widest vertical range of any camera in this list
Pan Scan auto-patrol cycles through 4 waypoints automatically
Motion tracking follows a moving pet without manual adjustment
limitations: Two-way audio is thinner than pricier alternatives
Cloud storage for longer clips needs an optional Cam Plus subscription
features: No subscription required for live view

products.name: Ring Indoor Cam (2nd Gen)
products.blurb: Key specs: 1080p HD video with color night vision, 115° horizontal field of view, Two-way talk.
strengths: Deepest Alexa integration for households already on Echo devices
Compact plug-in design with a simple swivel mount
limitations: 115° fixed field of view is the narrowest option in this list
No pan/tilt, unlike the Wyze and Tapo at a lower price
Ring Protect subscription needed to save and review clips
features: 1080p HD video with color night vision

products.name: WYZE Cam v4 2.5K Indoor/Outdoor Camera
limitations: Advanced AI alerts need a plan

products.name: Blink Mini 2 Camera with Weather Resistant Adapter
limitations: Person detection and clip history need Blink plan

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
